scientific_integrity: The limit formula is derived analytically from the published joint CDF, an exact change of variables, and dominated convergence. The strict bound below \(0.8\) follows from \(e^w-1>w\), not from numerical quadrature. The bundled computation is used only as a reproducibility check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the single dependent strip law \(Z=(X,X+V)\) with rate-one exponential \(X\) and independent uniform \(V\). It does not classify general leader-property distributions. The decimal value is a numerical evaluation of an analytically proved integral, and literature searches cannot exclude an equivalent calculation under unrelated terminology.
title: Exact leader-probability limit for an exponential–uniform strip law
